Subject: Request: SFTP drop + bridge letter for SOC 2 artifacts (audit window Oct 1–Sep 30)

Hi Logan,

We're the audit team assigned to Acme Cloud Systems' SOC 2 Type II this cycle. A couple of compliance items came up from procurement — they require that certain system-generated artifacts (server logs, evidence bundles >500MB) be delivered via SFTP rather than the trust portal for ingestion into their internal archive.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a scoped SFTP drop (write-only) for the audit team to pull artifacts for the audit period Oct 1, 2027 – Sep 30, 2028? We need temporary credentials that rotate and expire after the download window.
- We also need a signed bridge letter that confirms the covered audit period and the date range of the report. Acme's legal asked for a DocuSign-signed copy.

Also: please confirm the retention of access logs (we typically require 90 days), and whether downloads will be logged with IP + username. If you can provide an ephemeral trust-portal token as a fallback for smaller artifacts, that would be helpful.

Preferred contact for technical coordination: James Tan at Acme (cc'd).

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Senior IT Auditor
AuditFirm LLP

Attachment: none (we'll share the PGP public key in the next message)

Sara — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Mina (Security) and Marissa (Compliance) to scope the SFTP drop and get the bridge letter into DocuSign.

High-level plan:
- We can provision a write-only SFTP drop at sftp://sftp.redwood-inference.com/drop/acme-audit/ scoped to the audit folder.
- We'll issue short-lived credentials (one-time user + password) valid for a configured download window. Default window is 48 hours; we can extend on request. Credentials will be rotated immediately after the window and old creds revoked.
- We log: username, source IP, file paths, and timestamps. Logs are retained 90 days (we'll provide an export if needed).
- We'll create a DocuSign envelope for the bridge letter and send to the Redwood signatory.

Next steps I need from you:
1) Preferred credential delivery method — do you want the credentials posted to the trust portal one-time token (we'll add a second-factor link) or delivered via PGP-encrypted email?
2) If you require IP allowlisting, please provide the public IP ranges for AuditFirm and/or Acme.
3) If you plan to use automated SFTP pulls, please share the PGP public key or SSH key we should expect.

I'm attaching an internal SFTP instruction stub that outlines paths and our checklist.

— Logan
Logan Wright
